assign.outcome:
**A ramp is space BETWEEN and AROUND content, never the size OF a control.** One commit, `ba7c392` (yesterday's components pass), put controls on the page ramp. Both of this morning's complaints came from it.

![the homepage nav, before](nav-before-3440.jpg)
![and after](nav-after-3440.jpg)

**The homepage nav item, at 1280 / 1920 / 3440** - height, block padding, icon-to-label gap:

| | 1280 | 1920 | 3440 |
|---|---|---|---|
| before the pass | 38.2 / 9.6 / 15.6 | 40.6 / 10.2 / 16.6 | 45.7 / 11.5 / 18.7 |
| this morning | 37.6 / 9.4 / 20.3 | 50.1 / 15.0 / 32.4 | **67.6 / 22.5 / 48.7** |
| now | 38.2 / 9.6 / 15.6 | 40.6 / 10.2 / 16.6 | 45.7 / 11.5 / 18.7 |

**The cause, once.** `styles.css:76` `.sidebar-link { padding-block: calc(var(--gap-ramp) * 0.6) }` and `Sidebar.css:78` `.sidebar-link { gap: calc(var(--gap-ramp) * 1.3) }`. `--gap-ramp` is `clamp(1em, 1.5vw - 0.3em, 2.6em)` - it equals 1em only at its floor and is pinned at its 2.6em cap above ~1400px, so `x 1.3` is **3.38em** at 3440, not 1.3em. Not this morning's spacing-constants pass: yesterday's tree measures identical to this morning's, to the pixel.

**The same commit, the second complaint.** `.paging-toolbar` had its flat `0.45em 0.7em` replaced with a `vw` clamp - 19.8px of block padding at 3440 and 130.7px of chrome over the stage. Back to `0.45em 0.7em`: 130.3px at 1280 (held), **107.3px** at 3440.

![the paging toolbar, before](toolbar-before-3440.jpg)
![and after](toolbar-after-3440.jpg)

**The census.** 380 size declarations across the site read a ramp; **26** set the size of ONE control and are back in its own em (five sidebar and brand rules, sixteen component gaps, three nav-row paddings on `/imagine/design/navigation/`, the toolbar). A gap that separates SIBLING controls in a strip keeps the ramp - that is space between things. Ten more sit under `core/Page/**` and are listed in the log for the minion who owns it.

**Also, the owner's second ask:** Imagine and Notes are on the homepage rail, in `page.js`'s `sections` array (not `children:` - that would import every section's tree into the front page), so they are a rail row and a card. Six cards wrap differently from four, so `styles.css` gains one container query at 76em; measured at 11 widths, every row is now even.

![the homepage at 1920](home-1920.jpg)

**Written down so it does not happen again:** a dated addendum on [the spacing decision](/imagine/design/spacing/decision.md), and one rule each in the `css` and `layout` skills - the layout skill's old line ("the multiplier IS the old em number and only 3440 moves") was the belief that caused this, and is gone.

**Left:** the paging bar is still 2847px wide holding 1000px of controls at 3440, and its row is 89px tall because each dropdown carries a label - both are the bar's layout, which `graduate-3` is rebuilding right now. Verified: 24 loads over 6 pages at 400/1280/1920/3440, zero console errors.
